trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

**Diagnosis**
- checkout-api was on v2.3.1 in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy, with an 18% error rate.
- Release history showed v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production. (I skipped v2.3.1-rc since it was staging-only and unhealthy.)

**Rollback to v2.3.0**
- First attempt partially failed — the orchestrator halted after us-east, leaving us-west and eu-west on the broken v2.3.1.
- I retried, and the second attempt completed the rollout to all regions.
- Verified: all three regions now on v2.3.0, healthy, error rate down to 0.2%.

**Incident**
- Opened **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api; the on-call engineer has been paged. The first create request timed out, so I retried with the same idempotency key to avoid a duplicate page — only one incident was created.
- The summary documents the failure, the rollback (including the partial failure and retry), the recovered state, and follow-ups: root-cause v2.3.1 before redeploying, and investigate the orchestrator error from the first rollback attempt.
